summary: Brazil Potash Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the award of a Front End Engineering Design contract for mine shafts and underground development to WSP UK Ltd./Redpath Deilmann. This is an operational milestone for the Autazes potash project, not a special situation. The filing describes progress toward construction debt financing but contains no merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or other event-driven corporate transaction. It is a routine operational update by a foreign private issuer.
